info.title: CureCloud API
info.description:
REST API for CureCloud, a health management system for South African public hospitals.

**Authentication.** Every endpoint except the public ones takes `Authorization: Bearer <Firebase ID token>`.
Each operation names the permission it requires (also in `x-permission`); `GET /api/v1/me` returns the
caller's permissions. A resource the caller has no relationship to returns 404; a visible resource with a
forbidden action or field returns 403.

**Conventions.** Lists take `limit` and `cursor` and return `{ data, nextCursor }`. Creates return 201 with
a `Location` header. Timestamps are ISO 8601 UTC; request instants carry an offset. Multi-value filters are
comma-separated. Errors are RFC 9457 `application/problem+json`.

The data model and authorization rules are described in `docs/domain-model.md` in the backend repository.

bearerAuth.description: Firebase ID token from the signed-in client (`await auth.currentUser.getIdToken()`).

BadRequest.description: The request failed validation; `errors` lists each invalid field. Problem codes: `validation-error`, `malformed-json`, `invalid-cursor`.

Unauthenticated.description: The bearer token is missing, invalid or expired. Problem codes: `unauthenticated`.

Forbidden.description: The caller lacks the permission, or the action or a field is forbidden for this resource. Problem codes: `profile-required`, `account-pending`, `account-disabled`, `forbidden`.

NotFound.description: The resource does not exist or the caller has no relationship to it. Problem codes: `not-found`.

Conflict.description: The request conflicts with the resource's current state. Problem codes: `conflict`, `slot-unavailable`, `invalid-state-transition`, `record-immutable`, `duplicate-identifier`, `already-charted`.

InternalError.description: Unexpected server error. The response never contains request data. Problem codes: `internal`.

get.summary: Health check
get.description:
Unversioned, for uptime checks.

Public: no token required.

post.description: Public: no token required.

get.summary: The caller's account, patient record and permissions
get.description:
404 not-found means the caller is signed in but has no profile yet (call POST /me).

Requires a valid ID token; any account status, with or without a profile.

post.summary: Create the caller's profile after the first Google sign-in
post.description:
Creates a patient account and patient record. A verified email matching BOOTSTRAP_ADMIN_EMAIL creates the first system admin instead.

Requires a valid ID token; any account status, with or without a profile.

patch.description:
Patients may only change name here; their contact data lives on the Patient (PATCH /patients/{id}).

Requires permission `profile:update`.

get.summary: The caller's preferences, with defaults filled in
get.description: Requires permission `preferences:read`.

get.summary: Role-specific dashboard counters (discriminated by role)
get.description:
Counts are count() aggregations; the nurse medication counters come from today's medication schedule, and tasksDueToday and the overdue-task alerts only include tasks the nurse may read (patient tasks need current clinical access; at most 500 tasks are considered).

Requires permission `dashboard:read`.

get.summary: Aggregated report for the caller's scope (default: last 30 days)
get.description:
Doctor: care team patients, own appointments and prescriptions. Nurse: department and care team. Facility admin: facility (?departmentId=). System admin: everything or ?facilityId=. Admin clinical aggregates suppress cells below 5. Period at most 366 days; scans are capped at 2,000 documents per collection (meta.truncated).

Requires permission `report:read`.

get.summary: Admin user list, sorted by name
get.description:
System admins: everyone (or ?facilityId=). Facility admins: staff and admins of their facility plus pending unassigned staff; role=patient returns 403. q is a case-insensitive name prefix and combines only with role and status.

Paginated: `limit` (1-100, default 25) sets the page size; pass the previous page's `nextCursor` as `cursor` for the next page. `nextCursor` is null on the last page.

Requires permission `user:list`.

get.summary: Get a user account (404 outside the admin's scope)
get.description: Requires permission `user:read`.

patch.summary: Approve, disable, re-role or reassign an account
patch.description:
Enforces the invariants in §2.1: no self-change of role/status/facilityId/departmentId; only system admins touch admin accounts, patient accounts, role: admin or an admin's facilityId; facility admins manage doctors and nurses of their facility or pending unassigned ones and may only set facilityId to their own; the last active system admin keeps its role, status and null facilityId (409). Activating staff requires facilityId, departmentId for nurses, practitioner.licenceNumber and a verified Firebase Auth email (409 otherwise). departmentId must be an active department of the resulting facilityId, and any facilityId change must also set or clear departmentId (400).

Requires permission `user:update`.

get.summary: Directory of active doctors and nurses, sorted by name
get.description:
Patients only see doctors, without email.

Paginated: `limit` (1-100, default 25) sets the page size; pass the previous page's `nextCursor` as `cursor` for the next page. `nextCursor` is null on the last page.

Requires permission `practitioner:list`.

get.summary: List facilities, sorted by name
get.description:
Active facilities only, except for admins (?status=). Facility management is deferred.

Paginated: `limit` (1-100, default 25) sets the page size; pass the previous page's `nextCursor` as `cursor` for the next page. `nextCursor` is null on the last page.

Requires permission `facility:read`.

get.summary: List departments of the caller's facility, sorted by name
get.description:
System admins see every facility (or ?facilityId=). include=stats is for admins only.

Paginated: `limit` (1-100, default 25) sets the page size; pass the previous page's `nextCursor` as `cursor` for the next page. `nextCursor` is null on the last page.

Requires permission `department:read`.

post.description:
Facility admins create in their own facility; system admins pass facilityId. Names are unique per facility.

Requires permission `department:manage`.

get.summary: List patients the caller can access, sorted by name
get.description:
Doctors: their care team. Nurses: care team plus patients admitted to their department. Admins: their facility (system admins: everything or ?facilityId=). q combines only with acuity; admitted combines with neither.

Paginated: `limit` (1-100, default 25) sets the page size; pass the previous page's `nextCursor` as `cursor` for the next page. `nextCursor` is null on the last page.

Requires permission `patient:list`.

post.summary: Register a patient (walk-in, no account needed)
post.description:
Created in the caller's facility. Doctor and nurse creators join the care team. Admins may not send clinical fields. 409 duplicate-identifier when the ID number is already registered.

Requires permission `patient:create`.

get.summary: Get a patient (redacted per access level)
get.description: Requires permission `patient:read`.

patch.summary: Update a patient using the caller's writable field set
patch.description:
self: name and contact data (never identifier). clinical: demographics and clinical fields (doctors also status). administrative: demographics, identifier and active/inactive status (system admins also facilityId). Any other field returns 403 naming it.

Requires permission `patient:update`.

get.summary: The patient's care team (not paginated, at most 50)
get.description: Requires permission `patient:read`.

post.summary: Add a doctor or nurse to the care team
post.description:
Doctors may add while they are on the care team; admins within their facility. The added doctor or nurse must be in the patient's facility (or the caller's while that is unset); only system admins may add staff of another facility. Notifies the added staff member.

Requires permission `patient:manage-care-team`.

delete.summary: Remove a member from the care team (admins only)

post.description:
departmentId must be an active department of the patient's facility (or of the caller's facility while the patient has none, which the admission then sets). 409 if already admitted.

Requires permission `patient:admit`.

patch.summary: Transfer or correct the current admission
patch.description:
Nurses may change ward, room and bed for patients admitted to their own department only.

Requires permission `patient:admit`.

post.description:
Moves the closed admission to the patients/{id}/admissions history and sets admission to null.

Requires permission `patient:admit`.

get.summary: Vital signs history, newest first
get.description:
Excludes entered-in-error panels unless ?status=entered-in-error (clinical access only).

Paginated: `limit` (1-100, default 25) sets the page size; pass the previous page's `nextCursor` as `cursor` for the next page. `nextCursor` is null on the last page.

Requires permission `vitals:read`.

post.description:
Also rebuilds patient.latestVitals in the same transaction.

Requires permission `vitals:create`.

patch.summary: Mark a vitals panel entered-in-error (author only)

get.summary: List appointments, sorted by start
get.description:
Default scope: patient (own), doctor (own schedule), nurse (own department, or a clinical patientId), admin (facility). doctorId accepts only me/own ID for doctors unless patientId is set; nurses need patientId for doctorId (400). Facility admins' doctorId lists stay pinned to their facility; admins cannot combine doctorId and departmentId (400).

Paginated: `limit` (1-100, default 25) sets the page size; pass the previous page's `nextCursor` as `cursor` for the next page. `nextCursor` is null on the last page.

Requires permission `appointment:read`.

post.description:
Patients book for themselves; staff pass patientId. Checks lead time and booking window (400), opening hours, the doctor's leave and the 15-minute slot locks (409 slot-unavailable). When staff book for a patient with a facility, the doctor must be in it (400; system admins excepted). Adds the doctor to the care team.

Requires permission `appointment:create`.

get.summary: Get an appointment
get.description: Requires permission `appointment:read`.

patch.summary: Change status, reschedule or edit an appointment
patch.description:
Transitions per the lifecycle in §2.7. Patients may only send status: cancelled, cancellationReason, start and durationMinutes; a patient reschedule returns the appointment to pending. 409 invalid-state-transition when the change is not allowed from the current status.

Requires permission `appointment:update`.

get.summary: A doctor's busy intervals (bookings and leave), times only
get.description:
Window at most 31 days, default the next 7 days. Not paginated. Never says why a time is busy.

Requires permission `practitioner:read-busy`.

get.summary: List prescriptions, newest first
get.description:
Patients: their own. Doctors without patientId: prescriberId defaults to and must be me. Nurses must pass a clinical patientId (400 without one). Excludes entered-in-error unless asked for.

Paginated: `limit` (1-100, default 25) sets the page size; pass the previous page's `nextCursor` as `cursor` for the next page. `nextCursor` is null on the last page.

Requires permission `prescription:read`.

post.description:
category defaults to inpatient when the patient is admitted. administrationTimes default from frequency.

Requires permission `prescription:create`.

get.summary: Get a prescription
get.description: Requires permission `prescription:read`.

patch.summary: Hold, resume, stop or edit a prescription
patch.description:
The prescriber or a doctor with clinical access may hold, resume or stop. Only the prescriber edits endDate, refills, instructions and administrationTimes (while active or on-hold), completes, or sets entered-in-error (only if no dose was given).

Requires permission `prescription:update`.

post.summary: Ask the prescriber for a refill
post.description:
Only for the caller's own current outpatient prescriptions with refills left. Notifies the prescriber; nothing else is stored.

Requires permission `prescription:request-refill`.

get.summary: Scheduled doses for one day across the caller's inpatients
get.description:
Computed, not stored and not paginated. Current inpatient prescriptions of the caller's accessible admitted patients (nurses: plus their ward). PRN prescriptions are returned separately.

Requires permission `medication-schedule:read`.

get.summary: Administration history, newest first
get.description:
At least one of patientId, prescriptionId or performerId. Without a clinical patientId or prescriptionId, performerId must be me.

Paginated: `limit` (1-100, default 25) sets the page size; pass the previous page's `nextCursor` as `cursor` for the next page. `nextCursor` is null on the last page.

Requires permission `medication-administration:read`.

post.summary: Chart a dose as given or not given
post.description:
A scheduled dose is locked in administrationSlots in the same transaction, so it has at most one live administration (409 already-charted until it is retracted).

Requires permission `medication-administration:create`.

patch.description:
Releases the scheduled dose's administrationSlots lock in the same transaction, so the dose can be charted again.

Requires permission `medication-administration:retract`.

get.summary: List medical records, newest effectiveAt first
get.description:
Patients: their own, final and amended only. Doctors and nurses without patientId: authorId defaults to and must be me.

Paginated: `limit` (1-100, default 25) sets the page size; pass the previous page's `nextCursor` as `cursor` for the next page. `nextCursor` is null on the last page.

Requires permission `medical-record:read`.

post.description:
Nurses may only create nursing-note records. Finalising notifies the patient without clinical content.

Requires permission `medical-record:create`.

get.summary: Get a medical record
get.description:
Preliminary and entered-in-error records are not visible to patients (404).

Requires permission `medical-record:read`.

patch.summary: Edit a preliminary record, finalise it, or mark it entered-in-error (author only)
patch.description:
final and amended records are immutable (409 record-immutable); append an addendum instead.

Requires permission `medical-record:update`.

post.summary: Append an addendum to a final or amended record (author only)
post.description:
Sets status to amended. Addenda are append-only.

Requires permission `medical-record:update`.

get.summary: List care tasks, by dueAt (or completedAt desc with completedBy)
get.description:
assigneeId accepts me, unassigned and (nurses) a nurse of their own department; completedBy accepts only me; departmentId must be the caller's own. Doctors may use other actor values only with a clinical patientId. Default for nurses: own department, open and in-progress.

Paginated: `limit` (1-100, default 25) sets the page size; pass the previous page's `nextCursor` as `cursor` for the next page. `nextCursor` is null on the last page.

Requires permission `care-task:read`.

post.description:
Patient tasks need clinical access; departmentId is not accepted (it is the patient's admission department, or null) and the assignee must have clinical access (403). Ward-level tasks need departmentId: an active department of the caller's facility (nurses: their own); the assignee must be active staff of it. Assigning notifies the assignee.

Requires permission `care-task:create`.

get.summary: Get a care task
get.description: Requires permission `care-task:read`.

patch.summary: Claim, start, release, complete, cancel or edit a care task
patch.description:
open → in-progress → completed, in-progress → open (release), open|in-progress → cancelled (the creator, or a doctor with clinical access). Completed and cancelled tasks are terminal.

Requires permission `care-task:update`.

get.summary: The roster for a window, sorted by start
get.description:
Scoped to the caller's facility (a colleague's staffId list only returns shifts recorded in the caller's facility). staffId accepts me. System admins must pass facilityId, departmentId or staffId (400 otherwise); facilityId is for system admins only. Window at most 31 days (default: today plus 7 days). handoverNote is visible only to the owner and to doctors and nurses of the same department.

Paginated: `limit` (1-100, default 25) sets the page size; pass the previous page's `nextCursor` as `cursor` for the next page. `nextCursor` is null on the last page.

Requires permission `shift:read`.

post.summary: Add a shift or leave to the roster
post.description:
The staff member must be active and pass facility for the caller (system admins: any facility). The shift's facilityId is the staff member's facility and departmentId must be one of its departments. 409 conflict on overlap.

Requires permission `shift:manage`.

get.summary: The caller's current shift, the previous handover and who is on duty
get.description:
Same department, not paginated. previousHandover is never returned to admins.

Requires permission `shift:read`.

patch.summary: Edit or cancel a shift (admins) or write the handover note (shift owner)
patch.description:
Only the owner of a doctor or nurse shift writes handoverNote; admins never do (403).

Requires permission `shift:manage` or `shift:handover`.

get.summary: The caller's notifications, newest first
get.description:
Paginated: `limit` (1-100, default 25) sets the page size; pass the previous page's `nextCursor` as `cursor` for the next page. `nextCursor` is null on the last page.

Requires permission `notification:read`.

get.summary: Number of unread notifications (for the header badge)
get.description: Requires permission `notification:read`.

post.description: Requires permission `notification:update`.

get.summary: The caller's conversations plus their facility's channels, by last message
get.description:
Each item carries the caller's unreadCount.

Paginated: `limit` (1-100, default 25) sets the page size; pass the previous page's `nextCursor` as `cursor` for the next page. `nextCursor` is null on the last page.

Requires permission `conversation:read`.

post.summary: Start a conversation or create a channel
post.description:
direct: two active staff of one facility, or a system admin and any active staff member (returns the existing one with 200). group: 3–50 active staff of one facility. channel: admins (channel:manage) of the facility; system admins pass facilityId; departmentId must be in that facility. patient: exactly the patient's account plus active care team doctors and nurses, otherwise 403.

Requires permission `conversation:create`.

get.summary: Get a conversation
get.description: Requires permission `conversation:read`.

patch.summary: Rename or archive a channel (admins), or rename a group (participants)
patch.description:
Channels need channel:manage; groups need the caller to be a participant (conversation:read). Participants cannot be changed in v1.

Requires permission `channel:manage` or `conversation:read`.

get.summary: Messages, newest first
get.description:
Paginated: `limit` (1-100, default 25) sets the page size; pass the previous page's `nextCursor` as `cursor` for the next page. `nextCursor` is null on the last page.

Requires permission `conversation:read`.

post.description:
Updates lastMessage, lastMessageAt and the sender's read marker.

Requires permission `message:create`.

post.summary: Mark the conversation read for the caller
post.description: Requires permission `conversation:read`.

get.summary: System settings with defaults filled in
get.description: Requires permission `system-settings:read`.

patch.summary: Update system settings (deep merge, system admins only)

get.summary: Operational alerts for the admin's facility, newest first
get.description:
Facility admins see their facility's alerts plus system-wide ones (facilityId null); system admins see every alert.

Paginated: `limit` (1-100, default 25) sets the page size; pass the previous page's `nextCursor` as `cursor` for the next page. `nextCursor` is null on the last page.

Requires permission `system-alert:read`.
